notes: The centered, inset control-panel bezel has rounded corners. All 18 labeled keys have collision caps and spring-return joints. The readout follows persisted simulated machine state: program selection, countdown, pause/resume, editable duration/temperature/speed, modeled heating/cooling and RPM ramps, momentary short mixing, and menu field selection. Five independent presets initialize to the original 150-second, 45 C, 0 RPM values; all values, bounds and ramp rates are configurable in task.json. Display and press latches survive saved-state restore. The original Program 1 grading joint and ordered task rubric, physical wells, rack, tubes and friction caps are retained. Glyph meshes and the rounded bezel ship in the HF assets archive; runtime needs no font/build dependencies.
